subject: sunflower
title: Helianthus annuus - Jardin universitaire Roger-Van den Hende, Quebec 22.jpg
description: Sunflower (Helianthus annuus) is a large annual forb of the genus Helianthus grown as a crop for its edible oil and seeds. This sunflower species is also used as wild bird food, as livestock forage (as a meal or a silage plant), in some industrial applications, and as an ornamental in domestic garde
